_comment: Distilled rebalance the mod applies, datamined from 153_UnkillablesRebalance_P vs base via the forever-winter-datamine CUE4Parse decoder. This is the ground truth any rebuilt pak must reproduce. Values are float32. null-import diffs from the isolated mount are excluded — these are the REAL changes only.
_comment_builds: The VALUES below were datamined against 0.9.3.9.2 (24097213) and have not been re-datamined since; they have been re-verified present and correct in the shipped pak on each rebuild, most recently 25071553 (2026-09-11). target_game_build is what the CURRENT dist pak was built and verified against — it is not the build the values were derived on, and the two are expected to diverge. The export counts below are still stamped to 24097213; each structural_drift flag now carries a structural_drift_basis saying how it was determined.
_comment_built_and_verified: 2026-09-11 on 25071553: build_fix.sh all gates green (11/11 package ids); verify_build.sh clean (3165 references, 0 dangling, 0 properties dropped).
_comment_25071553_boss_schema_shift: MEASURED 2026-09-11, and the first DIRECT observation of unversioned-property index shift in this repo. Build 25071553 moved the AI character class schema. The v1.3 pak (built on 24536482), decoded inside a live 25071553 mount, mis-reads all 6 boss CDOs: values land on neighbouring properties (MeatMan FarDistance reads 150 where base has 750; that 750 reappears as CloseDistanceRadiusScalar; MaxExtraTurnVel's 90 as MinTurnAngle) and the stream then desynchronises - MeatMan 35 -> 19 properties, OrgaMech 31 -> 15, ShieldOfficer 29 -> 13, MotherCourage 32 -> 20, Opal 41 -> 25 - losing RootComponent / Mesh / CapsuleComponent / CharacterMovement / AIControllerClass / HealthComponentPrivate. CONTROL: the same v1.3 bytes read under the archived 24536482 usmap decode all 35 coherently, so the pak is not corrupt - the schema moved under it. Toothy is the count-blind case: 17 -> 17 properties with 8 of them under the wrong name, which no export-count or property-count gate can see. The 2026-09-11 rebuild decodes identically to live base on all 6. Caveat: this is a CUE4Parse decode under the live usmap, not an observed in-game crash. See WORKLOG.md Session 7.

boss_health._comment: FWHealthComponent DefaultHealth + DefaultMaxHealth in each boss's cooked BP CDO. Removes invincibility (1e9 / 9e8) -> finite killable HP.

stalker_aidef._comment: 4 Grabber/Stalker AIDEF DataAssets. DamageToStagger 20000->1000 = 20x easier to stun. SyncKillMaxPlayerHealth 2000->1000 = no sync-kill (instakill) grab unless player already below 1000 hp.
stalker_aidef._comment_build_strategy: 2026-08-05: these moved from Option A (rebase the mod's frozen 0.9.2.2 cook) to Option B (patch the current base cook), via tools/patch_stalker_aidef.py, on the theory that a drifted class schema was mis-decoding and causing the reported crash when SHOOTING the Grabber. 2026-08-23: that theory was MEASURED on 24536482 and is FALSE — all 4 rebuild byte-identical to the frozen cook, so this class never drifted and could not have been mis-decoding (see structural_drift_basis). Option B is kept because nothing frozen should remain in the pipeline and it drops the upstream/ requirement, but for this group it is a NO-OP in shipped bytes, not a fix. The reported Grabber crash has no established cause — see docs/diagnosis.md and WORKLOG.md Session 6. Note build_fix.sh step [2b] alone does NOT settle this: it cannot distinguish real drift from the rebalance this mod itself applies.
stalker_aidef.structural_drift_basis: MEASURED 2026-08-23 on 24536482: byte-compared the current base cook against the frozen 0.9.2.2 cook the pak was shipping. uexp lengths 206/205/202/202 B on both sides, same string set, and the only bytes differing from current base are the 4 belonging to the 2 rebalanced scalars (20000->1000 moves 3 bytes, 2000->1000 moves 1). Previously this flag was stamped from 24097213 export counts, which cannot see unversioned-property reordering; it now rests on a direct byte comparison. RE-MEASURED 2026-09-11 on 25071553: still byte-identical to the previously shipped copy, and 50/51/50/50 property shapes in base and pak alike - this class did not move in the 25071553 patch either, the patch that moved the boss character schema.

bpc_incoming_damage_mod._comment: /Game/FW/AI/Characters/Shared/BPC_IncomingDamageMod — shared damage-mod component. 19 float constants in Kismet bytecode (ordered EX_FloatConst; the small ints 1-9 are unchanged segment counts). These are armored-boss body/zone HP thresholds; the mod scales them down so armour zones are destroyable. base gained +33 exports vs mod (structural drift).
bpc_incoming_damage_mod._comment_24536482_regression: MEASURED 2026-08-23: the live 24536482 BPC decodes to 285 property shapes; the pak built for 24501089 decodes to 276 against that same live build, dropping 9 — the FuncMap entries 'Check if Weapon Silenced' and 'Clean Up Damaged Foes' (each with .ObjectName/.ObjectPath) and a new array-inner struct property. The patch also replaced MakeAINoise with MakeAINoiseForFactions and added WeaponUsesSilencer / Damaged Foe Factions. The 2026-08-23 rebuild ships 285 shapes, 0 dropped. This is the ONLY one of the 11 packages whose payload changed between 24501089 and 24536482 — the other ten rebuild byte-identical.
bpc_incoming_damage_mod._comment_25071553: 2026-09-11 on 25071553: the BPC dropped NOTHING this patch - 285 property shapes in live base, in the v1.3 pak and in the v1.4 pak alike, and its decoded values differ from base by exactly the 19 rebalanced doubles on both. Unlike 24536482, this patch's damage was confined to the 6 boss Blueprints.
